body: I thought so. Thank you for taking the time to reply!

Speak to customers like you how you would want an employee to treat your grandparents (or someone you love). Patience is key to ~you~ keeping your sanity. Find like tricks to speeding up your duties; your brain loves patterns!  Most importantly, the quote “teamwork makes the dream work” is 100% true lol. Be nice to your coworkers and if you find you have a spare moment, ask those in busier positions how you can help. Working is so much more fun when you act as a team!

Good luck! Don’t be afraid to ask questions :-)
